sources.snippet: One of our core aims at BottleCap is efficiency in AI. To fulfil this mission, we fine-tuned Qwen3.6-27B to reduce unnecessary reasoning while preserving answer quality.

sources.title: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B Cuts Reasoning Token Use by Half
sources.snippet: ThinkingCap-Qwen3.6-27B cuts reasoning token use by 50% while preserving much of Qwen's reasoning quality across key AI benchmarks.
